slots.notes: Center-card hero loop: muted autoplay video filling the top 75% of card 2, object-cover cropped, fading at its bottom edge into the card surface.
Self-hosted webfont 'Futura Md BT Medium' loaded via @import from onlinewebfonts CDN; carries every heading and body run in the section (display + body roles).

mechanic: A static black three-column rounded-card grid (text / video / text) whose only motion is a muted looping background video in the center card that fades seamlessly into the card surface.
techDelivery: single-file React + TypeScript section, utility-class Tailwind CSS, no extra libraries
reskinNotes:
Blob-blue accent is baked inline as a Tailwind arbitrary value bg-[#1e3a8a] (two occurrences) rather than a token; the video bottom-fade target to-neutral-950 must equal the card surface or a seam appears; surface is the Tailwind token neutral-950 not a raw hex; all copy is hardcoded in markup with
line breaks; the display font is referenced by the exact family name 'Futura Md BT Medium' in both the @import and font-family.
